criteria.name: Issue Spotting
criteria.description: Correctly identifies the legal/doctrinal question(s) actually raised by the case or hypothetical.

criteria.name: Rule Identification
criteria.description: States the controlling rule, standard, or test accurately, citing the source when applicable.

criteria.name: Rule Application
criteria.description: Applies the rule to the specific facts rather than restating it in the abstract.

criteria.name: Counterarguments
criteria.description: Anticipates and addresses the strongest opposing position.

criteria.name: Conclusion
criteria.description: Reaches a clear, supported conclusion rather than trailing off or hedging without resolution.

criteria.name: Organization
criteria.description: Presents the argument in a logical sequence a listener can follow without re-reading.
